evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, plus $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Any fees the court does not award would go to the class.

summary: Class counsel raised fees in its opening offer, before the parties settled on class relief. The proposed treatment of unawarded fees explicitly linked fees to the amount the class would receive. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its fees or a misleading declaration.
